HDPI-7656 (PR traceability only - this finding is master-wide and unrelated to Review Support Request): false positive. CVE-2026-41178 is an OpenTelemetry-Go advisory (GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835); its NVD CPE carries target_software "go" and covers < 1.42.0 plus exactly 1.43.0. PCS uses the Java semconv artifact, which is already forced to the latest published 1.43.0 in build.gradle - no Java release sits outside both Go ranges. Dependency Check matches it because NvdCveAnalyzer.ecosystemMatchesTargetSoftware only applies target_software filtering to the Node ecosystem. Re-review by the until date, or drop this entry once a semconv > 1.43.0 is published.

HDPI-7656 (PR traceability only - this finding is master-wide and unrelated to Review Support Request): false positive. CVE-2026-54285 is an OpenTelemetry JS advisory (GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf) against the npm @opentelemetry/core package; its NVD CPE carries target_software "node.js" and covers < 2.8.0. PCS uses the OpenTelemetry Java SDK, which is a 1.x line, so every Java artifact version falls inside that range and no upgrade can clear it. Re-review by the until date.
CVE-2026-59313/59314: fix is Enterprise-only on Spring 6.2.x (6.2.20) / OSS in 7.x; PCS uses neither SSE functional endpoints nor Content-Disposition built from input. Re-review by the until date.
